simple.meaning: לֹא רֻחָמָה (Lôʼ Ruchâmâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Lo-Ruchamah , the symbolic name of a son of Hosea.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: לֹא רֻחָמָה (H3819) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Hosea 1:6, with occurrences in Hosea.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לֹא רֻחָמָה (H3819) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לֹא רֻחָמָה (H3819) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לֹא רֻחָמָה (Lôʼ Ruchâmâh) / H3819 is traced through Hosea 1:6, Hosea 1:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: Lo-Ruchamah , the symbolic name of a son of Hosea
definitions.full: H3819. Lo Ruchamah רֻחָ֫מָה לֹא proper name, feminine ( uncompassionated: Ges § 152a , N) symbolic name of Hosea's daughter , Hosea 1:6 , 8 , compare Hosea 2:25 (see also 2:3 ). רֻחָ֫מָה in ר ׳לֹא proper name, feminine.

occurrences.englishText: She conceived again, and bore a daughter.
Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
